---
title: "Directory metadata opts out of Open Graph only"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta name="twitter:title"'
        -
          - '<meta property="og:'
---

The site enables `open-graph` and `twitter-card`, and this directory's `_metadata.yml` sets `open-graph: false`, so only Twitter Card metadata remains.
